measurement_method: Visual review of the user-supplied Google Street View panorama. Projected camera location is approximately 80 m south of the FID 431 footprint centroid using the project's local meter approximation.
observations: The target-looking facility appears low and single-story with a flat or very low-slope roof.
Its visible long facade has repeated tall ground-level service openings and an upper band of windows.
The panorama is distant and oblique; it does not resolve exact bay count, dimensions, wall construction, or measured height. The five-bay count and 5.36 m envelope remain modeling estimates.
uncertainty: The target identification is supported by camera location relative to Purdue GIS FID 431 and proximity to Hull Field, but this one panorama does not label the building or establish survey dimensions. Exterior materials are visually ambiguous.
